review_notes: Reviewed the current top-level proposal.json, not merely the prior_result proposal. Its complete 145 lines contain four supported writes on owned subjects and empty links, entities, merges and follow_ups arrays.

Independently read both owned files completely in canonical and rendered forms; enumerated all 15 subjects, 39 baseline facts and 21 outgoing links; read functionality.md and both disposition ledgers through their final pages.

All four proposed corrections are supported: carrier phase adjustment uses two s32 conversions; the Shouldered updater has a conditional no-op; the motion ID is not assigned to victim_gobj; and initial walking-input gating differs from changed-tier reentry gating.

Foreign definitions and active Donkey table entries substantiate the helper roles independently of rendered aliases. CargoJump input enters CargoKneebend preparation. CargoWalk collision delegates through CargoWait to a conditionally invoked CargoFall callback. The shared tier helper invokes, but does not retain, its callback.

Retained synchronization wording is justified only as corresponding motion-tier requests. Exact visual poses, on-back positioning and temporal alignment are specifically deferred below. Physics attenuation claims are supported for valid tuning; arbitrary taper gains and exceptional inputs are not asserted to reduce acceleration.

The functionality.md exceptional-values paragraph contains a nonblocking citation transcription error: c302741689bd67c3617faadb221df3193992c3 omits 'cd' from the pinned revision. Its substantive statements were independently checked against code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/ftwalkcommon.c#L16-L214. The proposal's evidence locators use the correct revision.

No additional retained-fact correction requiring a new write was identified. Acceptance does not resolve compiled layout, asset-level positioning, ownership safety or target-platform exceptional floating-point behavior.

unresolved.issue: All three section facts remain unresolved. No inspected compiled evidence establishes literal-pool extent, representation, ordering or relocation association.
Exact on-back positioning and matching visual poses are not proved by the carrier callback table. Corresponding victim motion-ID requests do not establish temporal animation synchronization.
Parameter suffixes #r3/#r4 are baseline identities, not compiled register-allocation evidence. The unused source-level 20-byte array does not prove stack layout or a gameplay buffer.

The code assumes valid carrier, user_data, compatible attributes, victim references and initialized walking state. This TU does not establish or release the grab relationship; destruction safety and ownership lifetime are not proved.
The tier-change callback is synchronous and non-retained, but Shouldered separately installs accessory1_cb. Its complete replacement, clearing and destruction lifecycle remains outside this review.

Finite positive animation lengths and rate denominators are not validated here. Zero/nonfinite divisors, invalid motion offsets and nonrepresentable float-to-s32 conversions have no safe target-platform result established by the inspected source.

Physics attenuation wording assumes valid tuning. The source applies (1 - ratio) * walk_accel_taper_gain only for 0 < ratio < 1; arbitrary gains need not reduce acceleration magnitude. Zero stick takes the negative base-acceleration branch, zero target skips division, and nonfinite inputs are not sanitized.
The dispatcher-local absence of attack and shield branches is proved. The rationale's global gameplay prohibition is not independently established and is not adopted.
